title: Watkins v. United States, 354 U.S. 178 (1957)
proposition: Congressional inquiry must relate to a legitimate congressional function; clarity and pertinency bear on witness rights.

title: Trump v. Mazars USA, LLP, 591 U.S. 848 (2020)
proposition: Special separation-of-powers considerations for congressional demands for presidential personal information, including third-party-held records; distinct from executive privilege.

title: Trump v. Mazars USA, LLP, 39 F.4th 774 (D.C. Cir. 2022)
proposition: Remand applied heightened scrutiny in the case after the presidency; substantial explanation did not eliminate necessary narrowing; discussed successor committee and reissuance.

title: United States v. Nixon, 418 U.S. 683 (1974)
proposition: Qualified presidential confidentiality analysis in a criminal-trial subpoena, not a universal congressional privilege override.

title: Trump v. Thompson, 595 U.S. 464 (2022)
proposition: Denial of interim relief did not conclusively resolve every former-presidential privilege issue; appellate discussion of former status treated as dicta.

title: United States v. Zubaydah, 595 U.S. 195 (2022)
proposition: State secrets may apply to harmful official confirmation of information reported publicly; private-contractor custody does not eliminate issue.

title: Eastland v. United States Servicemen’s Fund, 421 U.S. 491 (1975)
proposition: Speech or Debate protects legislative acts including subpoena activity within legitimate legislative sphere.

title: Gravel v. United States, 408 U.S. 606 (1972)
proposition: Aide protection turns on legislative acts; private publication is distinguished from legislative activity.

title: de la Torre v. Cassidy, No. 25-5353 (D.C. Cir. July 31, 2026)
proposition: Speech or Debate barred civil challenge to committee subpoena/contempt acts; denial of jurisdictional discovery upheld.

title: Committee on the Judiciary v. McGahn, 968 F.3d 755 (D.C. Cir. 2020) (en banc)
proposition: Article III standing held; other threshold objections expressly not resolved by that standing decision.

title: Joint Motion to Dismiss Appeal and Vacate Panel Opinion, Committee on the Judiciary v. McGahn, No. 19-5331 (filed June 10, 2021)
proposition: Primary filed motion records testimony under accommodation and request for dismissal/vacatur; not a merits appellate holding. Hosted copy of filed court document.

title: 28 U.S.C. § 1365, Senate actions
pinpoint: Subsections (a), (b), (e), and editorial note on repealed (c)
proposition: Senate-specific enforcement jurisdiction with executive-branch exception; not a general House statute; special expedition subsection repealed.

title: 2 U.S.C. § 192, Refusal of witness to testify or produce papers
proposition: Specified willful default and pertinent refusal are criminal contempt subjects.

title: 2 U.S.C. § 194, Certification of failure to testify or produce; grand jury action
proposition: Certification pathway for congressional contempt; distinct from automatic compliance remedy.

title: Winter v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc., 555 U.S. 7 (2008)
proposition: Four preliminary-injunction requirements and extraordinary discretionary character of relief.

title: Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 65
proposition: Notice, ex parte TRO conditions, and specificity requirements. Current rules portal separately checked; counsel must use current adopted rule text before filing.

title: Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, current rules portal
pinpoint: Current rules description and PDF access
proposition: Official route for checking adopted procedural rules; portal describes latest amendments in 2025.

title: Trump v. United States, 603 U.S. 593 (2024)
proposition: Criminal official-act immunity and restrictions on use of official acts; not blanket record privilege or comprehensive state-process holding.

title: H.R. Rep. No. 119-831 (September 15, 2026)
proposition: Current committee contempt recommendation concerning Leon D. Black; committee report is not criminal conviction or judicial cause-of-action decision.

title: 5 U.S.C. § 13104, Contents of reports
proposition: Existing financial disclosure content, amount bands and arrangements provide specific baseline for proposed disclosure study.

title: 28 U.S.C. § 2201, Creation of remedy
proposition: Declaratory remedy applies in an actual controversy within jurisdiction; statute is not an independent jurisdictional grant.
